proposals.evidence: Perder proposes, with probably, that kuitē because combines ku why and tē that. Example 137 supports the causal-subordinator meaning. The linking vowel and formation are retained as tentative. The ku why base has no reviewed ancestry; it is distinct from homographic ku do (karōti family), and this proposal must not borrow that unrelated accepted link. No independently established Nuristani loan direction.
proposals.save_blocker: Existing ku why base is unlinked; no bypass through homographic ku do.

approval: User: approve all; prefer Pashto where best matched, then Urdu for broadly Perso-Arabic terms. Approval includes qualified analyses, not a claim that uncertainties are resolved.
donor_policy: Prefer an attested Pashto donor where form and meaning fit best; otherwise prefer Urdu for broadly shared Perso-Arabic loans. Preserve explicit source attribution, phonological uncertainty and possible Nuristani mediation. Do not substitute a different dialect merely because its node is linkable.
